plain_summary: Boring global subsystem suppliers with real revenue and clean balance sheets will outperform US pure-play space SPACs over 3-5 years, anchored by Space Force / NRO procurement. Cheap heavy-lift launch shifts the bottleneck from getting things into orbit to building, connecting, and supporting them once they're there — radiation-hardened chips, optical inter-satellite links, ground stations, and component suppliers capture that durable value, not the headline-grabbing launch and applications layer.
